messages:
hannah: Starting canary for release/2024-07/ingest-proxy in the 20m change window. Please double-check the backout runbook (https://internal.redwood/runbooks/deploy-safety#canary-abort) before we kickoff.
priya: quick check: any data migrations or schema touches?
omar: none. config-only: increase worker pool size and a new feature-flag to enable async-ack. canary targets: 4 hosts us-east-1, 4 hosts eu-central.
ryan: noted. ops: confirm quick-unpin steps are good? linking emergency checklist: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/emergency-rollback
deploybot: Preflight OK: CI green, images pushed, health probes pass. Canary scheduled for 1725001800. :rocket:
qa-bot: QA watches: ingest, ack, and retry endpoints. Alert if 4% 5xx sustained for 2m or p95 > 1s.
hannah: canary started. ramping 2% -> 12% over 12m. tail logs: `kubectl -n canary logs -l app=ingest-proxy`
ryan: seeing elevated 502s on us-east-1. stack shows connection pool timeouts to persistence svc.
omar: rolling back DB pool size change in candidate? that should be safe. hold ramp while we inspect for 3m.
priya: hold ramp. i recommend we follow runbook step 3.2 quick-unpin if errors don't fall under threshold.
hannah: toggled feature-flag ingest.async_ack -> off (via `cfgctl set ingest.async_ack false`). monitoring 120s.
deploybot: Canary ramp paused at 12%. Flag toggle applied by hannah. Monitoring 120s.
ryan: errors improved a bit but still at 2.8% and p95 ~950ms. not baseline. i'm +1 to unpin now to avoid broader impact.
omar: agree, unpin path: `deploybot pin remove release/2024-07/ingest-proxy --reason "canary-5xx"` then traffic rollback -> clear local caches -> restart sidecars if needed.
deplybot_typo: (ignore)
deploybot: Unpin command accepted. Rolling traffic back to pinned release/2024-06. Rolling out us-east first, then eu. ETA ~6m.
qa-bot: running post-rollback checks: ingest success rate rising; p95 trending down.
hannah: executing cache flush on us-east nodes: `for n in $(kubectl get pods -l role=cache -o name -n infra); do kubectl exec $n -n infra -- redis-cli FLUSHDB; done`
ryan: after cache flush and sidecar restart on two pods, 5xx dropped to 0.6% and p95 back to 380ms. looks healthy.
priya: good work. i'll add a note in the release PR summarizing the backout sequence and linking the runbook + emergency checklist. Also creating follow-up to increase connection pool and add a circuit-breaker.
omar: when we reattempt, propose a staggered EU rollout (1 host every 90s) and bump connection pool by 30% in candidate image.
deploybot: Canary rollback complete across canary hosts. Notifying release-coordinator and oncall. :white_check_mark:
hannah: closing this canary; filing a short root-cause ticket and postmortem draft. thanks folks. :clap:
